mission.title: Hardlined Learning
mission.description: Recover a hardline architect's data before the imposter Agents take it.

npc.say: They took it... my precious data...

Oh, thank you. You're from Zion, aren't you? Please, take the data they were trying to steal, and keep it safe. Knowledge of the inner workings of the hardline system should not be entrusted to renegade programs such as these.

phase.briefing:
An unknown group is sabotaging hardlines throughout the City! This could have grave repercussions for Zion's operations in the Matrix. Unfortunately, we don't know enough about the mechanics of the hardline system to be able to track the group doing the damage.
A certain Exile program is known to have specialized in hardline system architecture before he was "retired" by the Machines. We've pinpointed his position, but I've just been alerted that imposter Agents have been spotted in the vicinity. Warrior, they may be after the same information that we seek. Zion must obtain this information before it falls into enemy hands!

enter.say: The Hardline Architect, Diego Lagenour, is in that building. I'm picking up multiple high-energy programs close to his location--Warrior, I fear that the enemy may have him in their clutches! You must hurry!

talk.say: They took it... my precious data...

done.say: The imposter Agents took the Hardline Architect's data.

objective.text: Kill all of the imposter Agents

done.say: Brilliant fighting, Warrior! The information we seek should be on the body of an attacker.

objective.text: Get the CD from the imposter Agent

done.say: That CD could hold the data we need, operative! Please take it to a hardline and upload it to Zion for analysis.

objective.text: Upload the CD at a hardline

mission.finish:
The data you uploaded appears to be exactly what Commander Lock was looking for, operative! Zion will thank you warmly upon your return.
Contact me when you are ready for your next assignment.
